repeatability.officialText: Students will be able to receive credit for completing this course up to 3 times provided they complete three different Advanced topics.

items.issue: The course page enforces 12 units of 3000/4000-level COMP courses but says additional prerequisites depend on the announced Advanced Topic and are not specified on this page.
items.action: Enforce the published 12-unit rule and verify the topic-specific prerequisites manually after the Advanced Topic is announced.

items.issue: Credit may be received up to three times only when three different Advanced Topics are completed.
items.action: Before counting a repeated COMP4045 enrolment, verify manually that its Advanced Topic differs from every prior credited attempt.

requisiteAndIncompatibility.officialText: 12 units of 3000 and/or 4000 level COMP coded courses. Additional prerequisite courses for the Advanced Topic will be listed on the SoCo website when the course topic is announced. Students who meet the prerequisites can request a permission code following the instructions for enrolling in CECC courses. You will need to contact the School of Computing to request a permission code to enrol in this course.
